span.p: more papers to collect, better training examples

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; font-size: 22px !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(18, 59, 24) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Layer 1 - Data Engineering
African sources, rights checked per paper
Parsed with GROBID and OCR, tables and pages kept
Scientific records: value, unit, conditions, quoted span
Build plane - your machines, internet allowed

div.style: color: rgb(52, 16, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Layer 2 - Model Engineering
Reasoning datasets, fine-tuning, preference tuning
Candidates scored on the total formula,
not on scientific quality alone

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Layer 3 - GraphRAG, build half
About 200 papers in one flagship domain
Observation nodes in a Ladybug graph
Full-text and vector indexes, extensions bundled

div.style: color: rgb(101, 16, 54) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ready to ship?
Extraction sampled and human-checked
Model beats the untouched base
Whole system verified with the network off

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fix the weakest layer
and rebuild

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
What ships - one offline package
MUFASA GGUF plus pinned llama.cpp settings
mufasa-graph and bundled extensions, no PDFs
Tauri desktop, local service and optional Wi-Fi client
MANIFEST.sha256 hashing all of it

div.style: color: rgb(60, 15, 79) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Layer 4 - Application, on the laptop
Orchestrates everything, one generation at a time
Context, output, thread and buffer caps
Runtime plane - no internet, 7 GB ceiling

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Answering a question
Retrieve 6 to 10 Observations, one hop
Generate a short answer, then validate it
Show quoted spans, page numbers and coverage

div.style: color: rgb(0, 70, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Scored separately
The GGUF is evaluated directly with llama.cpp tooling
Accuracy 50, speed 30, efficiency 20, minus thermal
So MUFASA must be strong with no graph attached

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Feedback
Bad answers and missing evidence, saved locally
Read by a person - nothing trains automatically
